{"metadata":{"description":"基于原版 DSH 扩展，提供项目层、用户层更完整 MCP 管理 || Extended from the original DSH code, providing more complete MCP management at both project and user levels","id":"gh:1343209811","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-project-mcp-manager","slug":"wldxiaobai/dsh-project-mcp-manager","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-desktop","dsh-plugins","mcp-manager"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"基于原版 DSH 扩展，提供项目层、用户层更完整 MCP 管理 || Extended from the original DSH code, providing more complete MCP "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"management at both project and user levels"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-project-mcp-manager"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A project-level MCP auto-loading plugin for DSH: write MCP server configs in
`<projectRoot>/.dsh/mcp"},{"id":"p4s2","text":".yml` or `.dsh/mcp.json` and they are mounted
automatically (via the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"client`) whenever a dsh
session opens in that project. Changes to the file hot-reload into the runni"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ng
dsh process, and tool visibility follows the session's original project
(`session.header.cwd`). T"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"he default
`dsh-project-mcp-manager` bundle includes the loader and the companion
`dsh-project-mcp-u"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"i` settings page for the web and desktop apps. The UI is
enabled by default and can be disabled inde"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"pendently; the loader keeps working."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Capability boundary** (dsh ≥ 0.2.1-rc.2): the official client owns the
protocol, reconnect, tool n"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ames, resources, and server instructions. Shipped
profiles already mount shared MCP resource tools. "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"Official configuration is
a profile-layer Cordis patch (with that layer's own HMR) plus
`plugin_mana"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ger`. This plugin still owns what the host does not:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"1. Project-level discovery of `<projectRoot>/.dsh/mcp.yml`, `.dsh/mcp.json`,
and the read-only legac"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"y `.mcp.json`.
2. Tool visibility isolated by the session's original project
(`session.header.cwd`)."},{"id":"p6s3","text":" `working_directory` does not retarget it.
3. The MCP file format, the `dsh-mcp` CLI, and the settin"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"g_directory` does not retarget it.
3. The MCP file format, the `dsh-mcp` CLI, and the settings page."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Project-file hot reload is this plugin's file watcher. It does not replace
official profile HMR. **T"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ransport types are decided by the official client.**
v0.9.x targets the dsh `0.2` line starting at 0"},{"id":"p7s3","text":".2.1-rc.2 (`engines.dsh` is
`^0.2.1-rc.2`). Hosts on dsh 0.2.0 stay on plugin v0.8.2. Hosts still on"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"
dsh 0.1.5 should stay on plugin v0.6.0."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"If this plugin is useful, a GitHub
star is appreciated.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Documentation"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Feature documentation lives in `docs/`, English and Chinese side by side:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Configuration format — native YAML managed
block, JSON dialect, divergences from the cordis dialec"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"t.
- Settings page — use the bundled UI, read
the server list, add servers (with fill from clipboard"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"), switch, remove, and
manage tools.
- Configuration sources and layers — the
seven-layer source mod"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"el, shadow priority, global vs project mounting, and the
read-only legacy Claude Code layer.
- `${VA"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"R}` expansion — mount-time interpolation and
its diagnostics.
- CLI `dsh-mcp` — scopes, write format"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"s, ownership contract.
- Query surface — `ctx.projectMcp`, the
`projectMcp/updated` event, exported "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"view types, and the semver contract for
the companion UI."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Design and release records (Chinese): dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 adaptation ·
dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 adaptation ·

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Project discovery**: the `session.header.cwd` of an active agent session,
plus the dsh process s"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"tart directory → walk up to the nearest ancestor
containing `.git` as the project root (falls back t"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"o the directory itself
when there is no `.git`).
- **Mounting**: each `(project, serverName)` pair i"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"n the project layers mounts
one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` instance (`ctx.plugin`) on the host ct"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"x and
registers it into the global tool layer; multiple sessions inside the same
project share a sin"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"gle connection. Before a workspace is focused,
project-layer fibers are created only for projects wi"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"th a live session or
the process cwd, and they unmount after a 5 minute grace. Once the user
focuses"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" a workspace, only that project stays mounted and the others
unmount immediately, so a desktop works"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"pace switch cannot leave another
project's tools in the global list. The catalog entry and watcher r"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"emain.
**Every
user-layer row mounts exactly one instance** (global, independent of the
number of pr"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ojects) — see
configuration sources and layers.
- **Hot reload**: chokidar watches each known projec"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"t root and its `.dsh`
directory (depth 1). The allow-list is that root, `.dsh`, and the three
config"},{"id":"p14s13","text":" files; every other path is ignored, so the watcher does not open
`lib/`, `src/`, or `build/` and a "},{"id":"p14s14","text":"Windows build can delete those directories
while dsh is running. Edits to the **exact** config files"},{"id":"p14s15","text":" of known project
roots — `<projectRoot>/.dsh/mcp.yml`, `<projectRoot>/.dsh/mcp.json` and
`<projectR"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"oot>/.mcp.json` — trigger a full reconciliation after a 150 ms
debounce: added rows are mounted, rem"},{"id":"p14s17","text":"oved rows are unmounted, and config
changes are remounted. A second watcher covers the
user layer as"},{"id":"p14s18","text":" **exact file paths** — `~/.dsh/mcp.yml`,
`~/.dsh/mcp.json`, `~/.dsh/profiles/<active profile>/mcp.y"},{"id":"p14s19","text":"ml` and
`mcp.json`, and
`$DSH_HOME/dsh-mcp.json` (the other plugin's global store; watched only so
c"},{"id":"p14s20","text":"reating it can be diagnosed, never mounted). chokidar v5 can deliver an
event for a watched missing "},{"id":"p14s21","text":"file when it is created, as long as its parent
directory exists — never the home directory at large."},{"id":"p14s22","text":" it is created, as long as its parent
directory exists — never the home directory at large.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Security boundary"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`stdio` lines in `.dsh/mcp.yml`, `.dsh/mcp.json` and `.mcp.json` spawn their
`command` inside the ds"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"h host process — config files are **executable code
carriers**, so only add them in projects you tru"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"st. The user layers
(`~/.dsh/mcp.yml`, `~/.dsh/mcp.json`, the profile yml and json) are executable c"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ode
carriers too, they just belong to your own machine: user-layer rows mount
**globally** (one host"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"-level connection, visible to every project) and are no
longer fanned out per project. Lines that fa"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"il to mount or are invalid are
skipped with a warning and do not affect other servers. Claude user-s"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"tate
monoliths such as `~/.claude.json` (mixing credentials with project history)
are **no longer re"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ad at all** as of v0.4.0."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The settings page writes the same managed files, so adding a local-command
server there spawns that "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"command on the host. Its routes
(`/api/project-mcp/*`) are served on the dsh connection: whoever can"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" use the
dsh web GUI can add and start servers through it."}],"truncated":true}
